explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/971: with p(a,d) the least prime ≡ a (mod d), is there c > 0 such that for all large d, p(a,d) > (1+c)φ(d) log d for ≫ φ(d) values of a? The statement counts a < d coprime to d, the only meaningful residues; for these p(a,d) exists by Dirichlet, so the sInf is genuine. It asserts c, C > 0 with count ≥ Cφ(d) eventually. Faithful.
